extraction.Name: Harry Brown
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee, but refused to take it until he was repeatedly advised by the Superintendent that if he did not take it and pay the taxes that the land would be sold to pay them
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: he still owns the land he got from his mother
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he has paid the taxes until 2 years ago, but that he can not pay them and must have aid from the Government or he will lose the land
extraction.Occupation/Income: he makes a living by common labor, making about $300.00 per year
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in poor health; has a wife and five children to support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since he was granted a patent in fee; exchanged his land for 160 acres of the allotment of his mother, which she held under a forced patent; document sworn December 5, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota | TASK 3 BULK TRIBE INFERENCE 2026-04-29: Tribe field set to 'Pine Ridge' based on directory provenance (record is filed in pine_ridge_*/extractions/, which corresponds to the NARA RG 75 Pine Ridge Vol 1, Vol 2, and Vol 3 bound volumes of Circular 2464 responses). 67 such records were originally 'not stated'; 6 received BLM-confirmed substantive patches in the same transaction; the remaining 61 (this record's batch) are inferred from directory and geographic/naming evidence. Inference is rebuttable — any record can be re-evaluated via BLM cross-reference if its Pine Ridge affiliation is questioned.
